export const meta = {
  name: "toil-shape",
  description: "Mini toil-block shape: fragments, notes, dynamic types, model pin",
  whenToUse: "Fixture only.",
  phases: [{ title: "Bootstrap", detail: "open a run" }],
};

// Constraints: plain JS, no imports, and no `Date.now()` / `Math.random()` / `new Date()`
// (comment-text mentions only — must not trip the banned-API check).

const CITATION_AUDIT_MODEL = "sonnet";

const INHERITED_PROPERTY = {
  type: "boolean",
  description: "True when an earlier step left evidence behind.",
};

const MINI_SCHEMA = {
  type: "object",
  required: ["status"],
  properties: {
    status: { type: "string", enum: ["ok", "abort"] },
    title: { type: "string" },
    detail: { type: "string", description: "One line for the manifest." },
    inherited: INHERITED_PROPERTY,
    notes: { type: "string" },
  },
};

const agentOptions = (spec, label) => ({
  agentType: spec.agentType,
  phase: spec.phase,
  label,
  schema: spec.schema,
});

async function dispatchWithOneResume(options) {
  const first = await agent(options.prompt, {
    agentType: options.agentType,
    phase: options.phase,
    label: options.label,
    schema: options.schema,
  });
  if (first) return { result: first, resumed: false };
  const second = await agent(options.prompt, {
    agentType: options.runnerType,
    phase: options.phase,
    label: `${options.label}:resume`,
    schema: options.schema,
  });
  return { result: second ?? null, resumed: true };
}

phase("Bootstrap");
log("starting");

const first = await agent("Open the run.", {
  agentType: "tl-runner",
  phase: "Bootstrap",
  label: "bootstrap",
  schema: MINI_SCHEMA,
});

const axis = await agent("Review the diff.", {
  agentType: "readonly-reviewer",
  phase: "Review",
  label: "review",
  schema: MINI_SCHEMA,
  model: CITATION_AUDIT_MODEL,
});

const codex = await agent("Post the mention with the GitHub MCP tool, never with gh.", {
  agentType: "tl-runner",
  phase: "Review",
  label: "codex-request",
  schema: MINI_SCHEMA,
});

const specs = [
  { prompt: "Do it.", agentType: "tl-fix", phase: "Fix", label: "fix", schema: MINI_SCHEMA },
];
const many = await parallel(specs.map((spec) => () => agent(spec.prompt, agentOptions(spec, spec.label))));

const solo = await dispatchWithOneResume({
  agentType: "tl-select",
  phase: "Select",
  label: "select",
  schema: MINI_SCHEMA,
  prompt: "Pick one.",
});

return { first, axis, codex, many, solo };
